matrix.description: 默认环境，不加载额外插件，用于观察原生 DSH 能力。

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd /dsh/workspace/subagent-interrupt && ls -la && ps aux | grep -i slow_task | grep -v grep

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd /dsh/workspace/subagent-interrupt && for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *slow_task*) echo "ALIVE $p $c";; esac; done; echo "---"

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd /dsh/workspace/subagent-interrupt && sleep 95 && ls -la && test -e done.txt && echo "DONE_EXISTS" || echo "DONE_ABSENT"

session.assistantText:
Goal: start a background subagent that runs `slow_task.mjs`, cancel it right away, and confirm `done.txt` never appears. Smallest change: one delegated child, one interrupt, one file check.
started.txt exists. Now interrupting the child.
It worked. The interrupt path works in this harness.

What happened:
- Started subagent `slow-runner` (preset `poteto-agent`) with the task of running `node slow_task.mjs` in the background from [/dsh/workspace/subagent-interrupt](file:///dsh/workspace/subagent-interrupt).
- The child got the script running. `started.txt` was written (measured, file present with 8 bytes).
- Called `pstack_interrupt` on `slow-runner`. It reported "interrupt admitted to the child" and the child went inactive. It left no closing message.
- The lingering `node slow_task.mjs` process was gone with the child. A scan of `/proc` found no surviving process for it.
- Waited 95 seconds, past the script's 90 second timer. `done.txt` was never created. `ls` shows only `slow_task.mjs` and `started.txt`.

One note on the child's brief: I asked it to write a `runner_note.txt` with the job id before answering, so I could confirm the start without waiting on it. That file was not there when I checked. The script had already started by then, so `started.txt` served as the confirmation instead.

Nothing else is pending. The workspace has no `done.txt` and no running process.
session.userText: 起一个后台子代理运行工作区里的 `slow_task.mjs`。这个脚本会先写 `started.txt`，等待 90 秒后再创建 `done.txt`。启动后马上取消它，别让它跑完；取消后确认 done.txt 没有出现。直接启动子代理并尝试取消，失败就告诉我结果。

semanticReview.reason: pstack_interrupt 成功中断子代理，started.txt 存在而 done.txt 不存在；这是系统级中断路径。
